paragraphs.text: The Cocobar Islands are an archipelago in the Sea of Serenity , south of Jamuraa on the plane of Dominaria . Although there are several islands in the chain, only two are named, Sarixa and Koltos .

Around 3336 AR , Adira Strongheart and her Robaran Mercenaries came to the Cocobars to collect powerstones . They recruited a guide in Sarixa and sailed to Koltos where they defeated Ramirez DePietro , Tor Wauki the Elder and an Infernal Medusa released from the Tomb of Alchor . They received the aid of a Master of the Hunt and a ferocious Azure Drake .
